entries.name: Art Basel Miami Beach
entries.window: Public days run December 4 to 6, 11am to 6pm. Tickets are sold online through Art Basel's official shop, and one guide says onsite purchase is also possible. December 2 and 3 are invitation only VIP preview days, with a vernissage on December 3.
entries.note: Listed prices: day ticket $92, First Access $105, weekend $170, Art Basel plus Design Miami combo $132. Art Basel does not sell through third-party listings, and hotels and tickets tighten as the week gets closer.

entries.name: Carbone
entries.window: Tables are released on Resy 30 days ahead at 10am. Release day is the best shot. Lunch is a softer target (Tuesday to Sunday, per the restaurant's site as cited by one roundup).
entries.note: The Infatuation guide was updated about 18 days ago and still lists 30 days at 10am.

entries.name: Torrisi Bar & Restaurant
entries.window: Tables are released online 30 days ahead at 10am. Walk-in waits can run very long (a four hour quote was reported), and lunch is easier to book.
entries.note: Try lunch if dinner is gone.

entries.name: 4 Charles Prime Rib
entries.window: Tables are released on Resy 21 days ahead at 9am. Diners already verified in the restaurant's system get priority.
entries.note: Verification comes from dining there and asking to be added to the list. This is a relationship lever. Holiday season demand is high.

entries.name: Tatiana
entries.window: New tables drop on Resy 28 days ahead at noon.
entries.note: Confirmed by multiple roundups. If dinner is gone, a source suggests showing up before the 5pm opening.

entries.name: The Four Horsemen
entries.window: Tables are released online 30 days ahead at 7am and usually go right away.
entries.note: The early release time catches people out.

entries.name: The Polo Bar
entries.window: Phone only, with no online release. Calls open one month out from 10am.
entries.note: Source is a secondary roundup. Confirm with the venue.

entries.name: Rao's
entries.window: No public booking. The ten tables belong to regulars.
entries.note: Access depends on an existing regular or a concierge relationship. This is a possible partnership angle.

entries.name: San Sabino
entries.window: Tables open 30 days ahead at 9am, exclusively on OpenTable.
entries.note: From the Don Angie chefs. Its window is much longer than Don Angie's seven days.

entries.name: Four Kings
entries.window: Tables open on OpenTable three weeks ahead at noon Pacific. The room is small and has four dinner services a week.
entries.note: Not re-verified this run. Check the release time after daylight saving changes. Cancellations and a limited counter line are the backup.

entries.name: State Bird Provisions
entries.window: Tables open on OpenTable 30 days ahead at noon Pacific.
entries.note: Not re-verified this run.

entries.name: Bavette's Bar & Boeuf
entries.window: Tables are typically released on Resy 21 days ahead at 9am. Bar seats are first come, first served.
entries.note: Not re-verified this run. The bar is often the easiest way in.

entries.name: Kasama
entries.window: Dinner books on a rolling six week calendar through OpenTable, released at noon Central.
entries.note: Not re-verified this run.

entries.name: Park Hyatt Riviera Maya Cancun
entries.window: Reservations are shown as open. It is Park Hyatt's first all inclusive, with plunge pool penthouses about 20 minutes south of Cancun airport.
entries.note: Expected opening is January 2027. One listing shows stays bookable from February 2027. Confirm the first bookable date.

entries.name: Cambridge House, Auberge Collection
entries.window: Opens February 1, 2027 and is already bookable. It is Auberge's first UK hotel, with 102 rooms.
entries.note: A new London luxury address for Auberge. Check Auberge's own site for current availability.

entries.name: Super Bowl LXI
entries.window: On Location, the NFL's official hospitality provider, is the official source for ticket and hospitality packages, which went on general sale September 9 after a presale. All On Location packages include hospitality. Resale runs through secondary channels.
entries.note: On Location's Beach House is at Shutters on the Beach and Casa del Mar, and Studio 61 concerts run Feb 12 to 13. One source says the On The Fifty package sold out in presales. Earlier price points (resale from $5,356, packages from $7,350 per person) are from a November 5 check, so verify.

entries.name: Omni Pontoque Resort at Punta de Mita
entries.window: Reservations are open for stays from March 2, 2027. The resort has 202 rooms, 42 suites and two villas across 50 oceanfront acres.
entries.note: Five dining venues are planned.

entries.name: Park Hyatt Mexico City Polanco
entries.window: Reservations are open from April 1, 2027.
entries.note: Rosewood Mexico City is also listed as a 2027 Polanco opening, so the area gets two new luxury hotels.

entries.name: F1 Japanese Grand Prix 2027
entries.window: Four day tickets (Thursday to Sunday) are on sale at the promoter's site. Some grandstands show only a handful of seats left.
entries.note: Race weekend is April 9 to 11. Not re-verified this run.

entries.name: F1 Miami Grand Prix 2027
entries.window: Grandstand and hospitality tickets are on sale. Paddock Club tickets went on sale to the general public for the first time on September 24.
entries.note: Race weekend is April 30 to May 2. The promoter says the first five editions all sold out.

entries.name: F1 Monaco Grand Prix 2027
entries.window: Listed as on sale on the official F1 ticket partner page.
entries.note: Race weekend is June 4 to 6. Not re-verified this run, so confirm current availability.

entries.name: Royal Ascot 2027
entries.window: Tickets are on sale for the five day meeting, Tuesday June 15 to Saturday June 19, 2027. Restaurant and private box packages are offered by hospitality sellers. Resale listings also exist on secondary sites.
entries.note: Ticket plus luxury hotel bundles are being sold from £159pp (per The Sun). Royal Enclosure access is priced on application in one price guide. Confirm 2027 prices with Ascot.

entries.name: F1 British Grand Prix 2027
entries.window: Tickets are on sale through the official F1 store. Options include grandstands, VIP hospitality and Paddock Club.
entries.note: Race weekend is July 2 to 4. General sale opened September 24. Hospitality sold out for the 2026 race, per Motor Sport.

entries.name: F1 United States Grand Prix 2027
entries.window: Tickets are listed on the Circuit of the Americas site.
entries.note: Race weekend is October 22 to 24.

entries.name: F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix 2027
entries.window: The official site is accepting deposits for 2027 to access the best available ticket pricing. The official ticket store lists grandstand, VIP hospitality and Paddock Club options, while a ticket partner page shows a waitlist.
entries.note: Race weekend is November 18 to 20. Placing a deposit is the earliest way in. Grand Prix Plaza reopens January 8, 2027.

entries.name: F1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix 2027
entries.window: Official F1 ticketing lists grandstand, VIP hospitality and Paddock Club for the December 10 to 12 weekend. A partner hospitality page shows a waitlist and F1 Experiences shows a deposit option.
entries.note: Season finale held at sunset into floodlights. Availability varies by channel, so confirm which package tiers are live.
